uzo.purpose: Sets its children in a grid of columns with the gap of a spacing step between them; a child spans as many columns as its data-span says.

instead.kialo: Records with the same fields that a person compares field by field are a table, because a grid of cards puts each record on its own and hides that the fields stand under one another.

boundary.kialo: The areas of a whole page – header, navigation, main part – are the frame of the screen, because they depend on the view around them; they belong to a Sxablono, and a person decides them until there is one.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section of a page lays its Eroj in a grid, because the section decides how many stand side by side and the layout Ero takes the gap from a spacing step.

with.kialo: Cards of the same kind stand in a grid, because a person scans them in rows and columns of the same width.
Lists of details stand in a grid, because a wide screen shows several of them side by side and a narrow one stacks them.

case.de: Die Kinder sollen nur untereinander stehen, in einer Spalte.
case.en: The children should only stand one below the other, in one column.

case.de: Die Kinder sollen in einer Zeile nebeneinander stehen und umbrechen dürfen.
case.en: The children should stand side by side in one line and may break into the next.

do.de: Nimm columns auto mit einer Stufe für min-width, wo die Zahl der Spalten von der Breite abhängen soll.
do.en: Take columns auto with a step of min-width where the number of columns should follow the width.

do.de: Gib einem Kind data-span, damit es mehrere Spalten überspannt; mehr als die Spalten des Rasters nimmt es nie.
do.en: Give a child data-span to let it span several columns; it never takes more than the columns of the grid.

dont.de: Eine Breite in Pixeln für min-width schreiben; die Stufen kommen aus den Containerbreiten.
dont.en: Write a width in pixels for min-width; the steps come from the container widths.

dont.de: Den Kindern einen Außenabstand geben, um sie zu trennen; der gap des Rasters ist der eine Abstand zwischen ihnen.
dont.en: Write a margin on the children to space them; the gap of the grid is the one distance between them.

none.de: Das Raster nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste; seine Kinder behalten ihre Reihenfolge beim Lesen und mit Tab, Zeile für Zeile.
none.en: The grid takes neither the focus nor a key; its children keep their order in the reading and the tab sequence, row by row.
